name: apkrunner
description: A real Android device in the cloud for Claude: install the APK you just built, tap through it, read the screen and logcat. Works where an emulator can't start, like Claude Code on the web.

api_key.title: ApkRunner API key
api_key.description: Make one at https://apkrunner.com/account (sign in, Create a key). It starts with ark_.
